'''Tannor Nuum''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] working for [[Janelle Serap]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seikosha/Legends|Seikosha]]. Nuum was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Chiron Drebbick]].
